knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Product application may need a licence or authority that depends on location. The authority must be checked before any product is used.
Label conditions, including re-entry and buffer distances, are mandatory conditions of use. They are followed as written.
Fertiliser that reaches a stormwater drain can pollute waterways. The spill is swept back onto the lawn or into a container, away from the drain.

practicalCriteria: Given a supplied mock product label and safety data sheet, the learner states the target, the rate, the buffer, the re-entry period and the protective equipment within the assessor's set time.
The learner completes an authority check record for a supplied mock job, stating whether the business is authorised and recording the rule relied on.
The learner contains a supplied mock fertiliser spill and places it into a container, with no mock product entering the mock drain.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed label and safety data sheet summary, signed by the assessor.
Authority check record for the mock job.
Assessor observation record of the spill containment.
stopWorkCriteria: Opening or using a mock product with no label during the assessment.
Applying a mock product in the simulated wind condition the assessor has specified as unsafe.
Washing a mock product spill toward the mock drain.
